name: compact-agent-panel
goal: The Work with agent composer uses less vertical space while keeping provider, model, effort, design count and send available and responsive

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Existing composer stacks mode, provider and settings. Acceptance: footer at most 115px at 1440 and 390; retain controls and approval gating.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: TAKE_SCREENSHOT=true SCREENSHOT_LABEL=before bun run test:e2e compact-agent.spec.ts: four expected failures, footer 141px functions and 181px components versus 115px; screenshots in /tmp/compact-agent-evidence.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Claude Opus 5.5 implemented the scoped compact Composer variant and grouped provider controls; reviewed all three assigned files.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged four height regressions pass at 1440 and 390; selected provider/model/effort/design-count send test passes; 29 affected browser tests pass. Fresh after screenshots captured in /tmp/compact-agent-evidence.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: bun run check passed in full: root, reporting, planning, desktop, collaboration, hub, remote and relay checks; desktop 810 unit/integration tests and 153 browser tests passed. Four red/green layout tests and selected-settings regression passed; desktop/mobile screenshots inspected. Manual in-app browser confirmed 89px/88px footer, count selection, Escape and focus restoration. Optional live/scale/simulator-build cases remain skipped by normal suite configuration; no physical device installation or application deployment is claimed.
